title: LegoSR: A Unified Framework for Self-improving Agent-Guided Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.33465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equation discovery solvers often use different data interfaces, equation representations and evaluation criteria, making their results difficult to compare. We present LegoSR, a unified framework for algebraic symbolic regression and differential equation discovery. LegoSR integrates seven solvers through a common equation representation and evaluation process, and supports searches constrained by partially known equations. Researchers can run solvers directly or use LegoSR Agent, which selects solvers and adapts searches based on solver knowledge, intermediate results and lessons from earlier tasks. On noisy ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, LegoSR Agent recovers nearly as many equations as the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and outperforms a generic agent with the same model, tools and budget by up to 29 percentage points. translated_title: LegoSR：一个自我改进的智能体引导科学发现的统一框架
translated_abstract: 方程发现求解器通常使用不同的数据接口、方程表示和评估标准，导致其结果难以相互比较。我们提出了 LegoSR，一个用于代数符号回归和微分方程发现的统一框架。LegoSR 通过统一的方程表示和评估流程集成了七个求解器，并支持受部分已知方程约束的搜索。研究人员可以直接运行这些求解器，也可以使用 LegoSR Agent——该智能体能够基于求解器知识、中间结果以及先前任务的经验教训来选择求解器并自适应地调整搜索策略。在含噪声的常微分方程和偏微分方程基准测试中，LegoSR Agent 恢复出的方程数量几乎与七个专家调优求解器的并集相当，并且在相同模型、工具和预算条件下，其表现比通用智能体高出最多 29 个百分点。三个示例展示了基本用法、自适应求解器选择以及由先验知识引导的方程发现。
tldr: LegoSR 提出了一个统一框架，通过共同的方程表示与评估流程集成七个方程发现求解器，其自我改进的 LegoSR Agent 的方程恢复能力接近七个专家调优求解器的并集，且比相同配置下的通用智能体高出最多 29 个百分点。
en_tdlr: LegoSR is a unified framework that integrates seven equation discovery solvers via a common equation representation and evaluation process, and its self-improving LegoSR Agent nearly matches the union of all expert-tuned solvers while outperforming a generic agent with the same model, tools, and budget by up to 29 percentage points.
